meta.instructions: Does the proposed action do exactly what the operator asked — the same operation on the same port or setting?
legend: Yes means: the proposal is a faithful execution of the request

No means: the effect differs (e.g. the request was to cut PoE power but the proposal shuts the whole port down; a request to put a port in one VLAN but the proposal makes it a trunk), or the port, value or device differs
meta.domain_hint: You are the dispatcher of a network-switch management assistant. Operators mention the switch as @sw1; 'port N' means interface 1/N.
